goal: Sam (drawn young, about five years old) sits in the reading corner with a picture book on his lap and waves.
colorPrompt: Compose one children's book picture from the element pictures. Picture 1 is the classroom with a reading corner: a wooden floor with a red rug, bookshelves, a table, and a cream wall with dark-brown timber beams. Use its walls, floor, rug, and bookshelves as the background and keep the same classroom, framed closer with a low camera. Picture 2 shows the boy Sam: the four 3D views at the bottom are the approved character, and the flat drawing at the top is only a hint, so copy the 3D look. Picture 3 shows a picture book. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. Keep Sam exactly as in the 3D views of picture 2: Sam: short brown hair with a side-swept fringe, big brown eyes, a big open-mouth smile, a red T-shirt with two white stripes, blue shorts, blue shoes; he is five years old and has a chibi look with a big head and a small body. The picture: a full-body shot from the front at a low camera height. Sam sits cross-legged on the red rug in the middle of the picture, faces the camera, and fills about two thirds of the frame height. The picture book of picture 3 lies open on his lap, large and clearly seen, with pictures on its pages and no writing. He waves hello with his raised right hand (on the left side of the picture), open, palm toward the viewer, with five clear small fingers and a thumb, and a big open-mouth smile. His other hand rests on the book. The bookshelves of picture 1 stand behind him. Hands are small, chubby child hands with five clear short fingers and a thumb when open, never fists unless stated. A hand that reaches toward the camera looks larger because of perspective; that is correct. Clean eye corners with no skin flaps, no streak on the forehead, and no marks on the face. Rendering errors to NOT copy from the character pictures: a tiny dark tick mark or pale skin flap at the outer corner of an eye (the corner next to the ear), and a faint pale crease on a forehead. Each eye ends in a smooth, rounded corner. Nan alone keeps one short, thick, curved eyelash flick at each outer eye corner. The page text is "Hello, I am Sam." and is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing on any picture or sign. The picture is for young children and is rated G. Every open hand shows exactly five digits: four separate fingers and one thumb. Count them: a hand with three fingers and a thumb is wrong. A waving hand: the palm faces the viewer, the four fingers are spread a little, and the thumb points out to the side. The ears are smooth, with one clean rounded rim. Each piece of clothing is one even color with no pale patches, no pale blotches at the shoulders, and no stains. Hanging hands are relaxed with separate short fingers and a thumb, not a lump and not a fist. The face has no line, crease, or streak on the forehead, even a faint one. The red rug is one plain rug with a smooth edge, with no tassels and no fringe.
